title: 卡兹克·亮彩手绘 Sketch
description: 紫色虫形身躯覆分节甲壳，三角头部与收拢翅翼轮廓清楚。

art_direction.medium: bright colored-pencil sketch, confident graphite contours, visible cross-hatching and selective gouache on pale drawing paper
art_direction.identity: Kha'Zix is a purple insectoid Void creature with a narrow triangular head, bright eyes, segmented armor, folded wing cases, powerful hind legs, and two scythe-like forelimbs. Preserve the distinctive mantis anatomy rather than a humanoid body. Both forelimbs are folded harmlessly near the torso, the mouth stays closed, and no gore, exposed innards, dripping fluids, or attacking lunge appears.
art_direction.scene: A broad full-body study, weight settled naturally on the feet or canonical support, expansive silhouette and an economical pale environment cue. Build the composition around this champion's defining anatomy and core motif. Only a few light environment marks; keep the picture predominantly bright and colorful.
art_direction.palette: violet, teal reflection, copper edge, pale slate; high-value vivid local color, luminous warm-white paper, bright chromatic shadows, limited canonical dark details
art_direction.weapon_policy: iconic static prop, no attacks or firing

visual_qa.method: Compressed JPEG contact sheet, max edge 1280 and under 350 KB
